svg.title: WUWEI: agentic delivery, one day
svg.desc: A ranked queue you approve feeds an agent team working three parallel lanes that loop build and check, every candidate passes the gates within the round cap, pull requests wait in a stack the shepherd sweeps until they merge, and you answer the odd card from the phone while guards, heartbeat, lead and steward work under the hood and each day's retro feeds tomorrow's plan.
svg.text: A team of agents runs your delivery day. You set the work and keep the final say.
tomorrow's plan carries what was learned
a seat asks through a decision record
you answer from the phone, or the mandate answers
lead: discovery when the queue runs low
steward: retro at close, you promote

g.text: answers a card now and then
answers a card now and then
